metadata.title: Rucaparib (Tablets) Monotherapy
metadata.indication: First-line maintenance of advanced high-grade ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer after response to platinum therapy.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00904 Version 1. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

non_haematological_toxicity_grade.label: Other clinically relevant non-haematological toxicity grade

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care may be limited.

non_haematological_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the named toxicity and grade it using the applicable CTCAE term rather than a generic impression.

hypersensitivity_grade.label: Infusion or hypersensitivity reaction grade

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild transient reaction; interruption not indicated.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Prolonged or recurrent reaction; hospitalisation indicated.

hypersensitivity_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess timing, treatment required, recurrence and airway or haemodynamic compromise.
